title: pittosporum abyssinicum subsp. engleri
intro: Pittosporum abyssinicum subsp. engleri, commonly known as the East African Pittosporum, is a plant species within the Pittosporaceae family, native to East Africa. The East African Pittosporum is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in treating wounds, infections, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic potential.
